        }), " ", _jsxs(_components.strong, {

        }), " 和 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "nodeTaints"
        }), " 是一套逻辑的两个侧面：一个用 nodeSelector 把 pod \"吸\"到特定节点，一个用 taint 把不合适的 pod \"挡\"在外面。"]
      })
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["一个容易绕晕的点：", _jsx(_components.code, {

        children: "tolerations"
      }), " 看起来重复。语义是这样的——", _jsx(_components.code, {

      }), " 声明\"节点很挑，带了污点\"，", _jsx(_components.code, {

        children: "nodeTaints"

        children: "tolerations"

    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {

    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {

      children: _jsxs(_components.code, {
        className: "hljs language-go",

          className: "hljs-keyword",

    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["ClusterQueue 的 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "nominalQuota"

      }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: ["ClusterQueue 的 heap 才使用优先级、时间和公平共享等比较规则排序；它的堆顶是“本 CQ 当前最该被调度的 Workload”。", _jsx(_components.code, {

    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.h3, {

      children: "3. 暂不可准入的 Workload 去哪了"
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["并不是所有 Workload 从 ClusterQueue 堆中取出后都能准入。命名空间不匹配、AdmissionCheck 失败、ClusterQueue 不存在或不活跃，以及资源无法分配等情况，都会让本轮尝试失败。失败的 Workload 不能直接丢掉，但也不适合在条件没有变化时反复占用调度周期，因此 Queue Manager 在 active heap 之外维护了 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "inadmissibleWorkloads"
      }), "。"]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["这里的 active heap 是“当前可以被调度器选取并尝试准入的 Workload 优先队列”。", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "inadmissibleWorkloads"
      }), " 则保存已经尝试过、但暂时没有必要立即重试的 Workload。两者都是 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "kueue-controller-manager"
      }), " 进程中的内存结构，不是 Workload API 上的状态字段，也不会作为单独对象写入 Etcd。"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.h4, {
      id: "从-active-heap-到-inadmissibleworkloads",
      children: "从 active heap 到 inadmissibleWorkloads"
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "一次失败重排可以概括为："
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsx(_components.code, {
        className: "hljs language-text",
        children: "active heap\n    │ ClusterQueue.Pop()\n    ▼\ninflight\n    │ nominate / flavor 分配 / 准入失败\n    ▼\nScheduler.requeueAndUpdate()\n    │\n    ▼\nManager.RequeueWorkload()\n    │\n    ├─ 立即重回 active heap\n    └─ 进入 inadmissibleWorkloads\n"
      })
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "Heads()"
      }), " 从每个 ClusterQueue 的堆顶弹出一个 Workload 后，", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "ClusterQueue.Pop"
      }), " 会把它记录为 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "inflight"
      }), "，表示调度器正在处理该对象。调度失败后，", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "Scheduler.requeueAndUpdate"
      }), " 调用 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "Manager.RequeueWorkload"
      }), "。Manager 会重新读取最新的 Workload，确认对象仍然存在、尚未获得 quota reservation，然后把它加回 LocalQueue，并调用 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "ClusterQueue.RequeueIfNotPresent"
      }), " 决定它回到 active heap 还是进入 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "inadmissibleWorkloads"
      }), "。"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsxs(_components.code, {
        className: "hljs language-go",
        children: [_jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-comment",
          children: "// pkg/queue/cluster_queue.go"
        }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-function",
          children: [_jsx(_components.span, {
            className: "hljs-keyword",
            children: "func"
          }), " ", _jsx(_components.span, {
            className: "hljs-params",
            children: "(c *ClusterQueue)"
          })]
        }), " RequeueIfNotPresent(wInfo *workload.Info, reason RequeueReason) ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-type",
          children: "bool"
        }), " {\n    ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "if"
        }), " c.queueingStrategy == kueue.StrictFIFO {\n        ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "return"
        }), " c.requeueIfNotPresent(wInfo, reason != RequeueReasonNamespaceMismatch)\n    }\n    ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "return"
        }), " c.requeueIfNotPresent(wInfo,\n        reason == RequeueReasonFailedAfterNomination || reason == RequeueReasonPendingPreemption)\n}\n"]
      })
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "这个分支体现了两种策略的差别："
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.ul, {
      children: ["\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "StrictFIFO"
        }), " 通常把失败的队头立即放回 active heap，继续保持它对后续 Workload 的顺序约束；namespace 不匹配是例外，因为在 namespace 标签变化前反复尝试没有意义。"]
      }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "BestEffortFIFO"
        }), " 会把普通的资源不匹配或配额不足结果放进 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "inadmissibleWorkloads"
        }), "，等待相关资源发生变化。已经算出可行的 flavor 和配额方案、但在后续准入操作中失败的 Workload，以及已经发起抢占、正在等待目标释放资源的 Workload，会直接放回 active heap，使其能够在后续调度周期继续尝试。"]
      }), "\n"]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["后两种情况分别对应 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "RequeueReasonFailedAfterNomination"
      }), " 和 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "RequeueReasonPendingPreemption"
      }), "，它们并不表示 Workload 已经准入。"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: _jsxs(_components.strong, {
        children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "FailedAfterNomination"
        }), "：资源方案可行，但后续操作失败"]
      })
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["这里的 nomination 是 Kueue scheduler 内部的 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "nominated"
      }), " 状态，不是 Kubernetes 默认调度器给 Pod 记录的 nominated node。它表示 Kueue 已经为 Workload 算出可行的 ResourceFlavor 和配额方案，并选中它准备执行准入："]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsx(_components.code, {
        className: "hljs language-text",
        children: "取出 Workload\n    ↓\n计算 ResourceFlavor 和配额\n    ↓\n判断可以适配 Fit\n    ↓\n标记 nominated\n    ↓\n更新 Cache、写 status.admission\n"
      })
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["例如，", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "train-a"

      }), " 等待配额变化没有意义，所以 ", _jsx(_components.code, {

        children: "FailedAfterNomination"

          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "if"
        }), " e.status != notNominated && e.requeueReason == queue.RequeueReasonGeneric {\n        e.requeueReason = queue.RequeueReasonFailedAfterNomination\n    }\n    ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-comment",
          children: "// ..."
        }), "\n}\n"]
      })
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "这个 Workload 随后回到 active heap，表示它可以在后续调度周期再次被选取，并不是在当前函数中立即循环重试，也不保证下一轮一定成功。"
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: _jsxs(_components.strong, {
        children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "PendingPreemption"
        }), "：已经发起抢占，但资源尚未释放"]
      })
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["另一种情况是当前配额不够，但 Kueue 已经找到可以被抢占的低优先级 Workload。例如，高优先级的 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "train-a"
      }), " 需要 4 CPU，Kueue 选中 ", _jsx(_components.code, {

      })
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {

        children: "train-a"

    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "三类失败的区别如下："
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.table, {
      children: [_jsx(_components.thead, {

          }), _jsx(_components.td, {
            children: "active heap"
          })]
        })]
      })]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["例如，", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "train-a"
      }), " 比 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "job-b"
      }), " 更早进入同一个 ClusterQueue，两者优先级相同。", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "train-a"

    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.h4, {
      id: "重新尝试由相关事件触发",
      children: "重新尝试由相关事件触发"
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["普通 inadmissible Workload 不是靠固定周期轮询重新调度。Kueue 等待可能改变准入结果的事件，再调用 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "Manager.QueueInadmissibleWorkloads"
      }), "。常见触发来源包括："]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.ul, {

    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {

      }), "，但 ClusterQueue 没有覆盖这种资源。只要配置不变，反复计算都只会得到同一个失败结果，因此它可以一直留在 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "inadmissibleWorkloads"
      }), "。管理员给 ClusterQueue 增加 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "nvidia.com/gpu"
      }), " 的 ResourceFlavor 和 quota 后，ClusterQueue 更新事件会触发重新排队："]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsx(_components.code, {
        className: "hljs language-text",
        children: "ClusterQueue Update\n    │\n    ▼\nManager.QueueInadmissibleWorkloads()\n    │\n    ▼\nrequeueWorkloadsCQ()\n    │ 同一 Cohort 时遍历相关 ClusterQueue\n    ▼\nClusterQueue.QueueInadmissibleWorkloads()\n    │\n    ▼\nactive heap\n    │ Broadcast()\n    ▼\nHeads() 被唤醒，调度器再次尝试\n"
      })
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["如果 ClusterQueue 属于 Cohort，资源释放或配额变化可能影响的不只是当前 ClusterQueue。", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "requeueWorkloadsCQ"
      }), " 会从 Cohort 根节点向下遍历，把相关 ClusterQueue 中的 inadmissible Workload 都纳入重新检查；没有 Cohort 时，只处理当前 ClusterQueue。"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.h4, {
      id: "移回-active-heap-前还会检查条件",
      children: "移回 active heap 前还会检查条件"
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "QueueInadmissibleWorkloads"
      }), " 并不会无条件清空暂存集。它逐个检查 Workload 所在的 namespace 是否还能读取、namespace 标签是否匹配 ClusterQueue selector，以及退避等待时间是否结束。仍不满足条件的对象继续留在 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "inadmissibleWorkloads"
      }), "，其余对象才进入 active heap。"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsxs(_components.code, {
        className: "hljs language-go",
        children: [_jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-comment",
          children: "// pkg/queue/cluster_queue.go"
        }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-function",
          children: [_jsx(_components.span, {
            className: "hljs-keyword",
            children: "func"
          }), " ", _jsx(_components.span, {
            className: "hljs-params",
            children: "(c *ClusterQueue)"
          })]
        }), " QueueInadmissibleWorkloads(ctx context.Context, client client.Client) ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-type",
          children: "bool"
        }), " {\n    ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-comment",
          children: "// ..."
        }), "\n    ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "for"
        }), " key, wInfo := ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "range"
        }), " c.inadmissibleWorkloads {\n        ns := corev1.Namespace{}\n        err := client.Get(ctx, types.NamespacedName{Name: wInfo.Obj.Namespace}, &ns)\n        ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "if"
        }), " err != ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-literal",
          children: "nil"
        }), " ||\n            !c.namespaceSelector.Matches(labels.Set(ns.Labels)) ||\n            !c.backoffWaitingTimeExpired(wInfo) {\n            inadmissibleWorkloads[key] = wInfo\n        } ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "else"
        }), " {\n            moved = c.heap.PushIfNotPresent(wInfo) || moved\n        }\n    }\n    ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-comment",
          children: "// ..."
        }), "\n    ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "return"
        }), " moved\n}\n"]
      })
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["只要至少有一个 Workload 被移回 active heap，Manager 就调用 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "Broadcast()"
      }), "。前面的 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "Heads()"
      }), " 可能正因为所有 active heap 都为空而阻塞在条件变量上，Broadcast 会唤醒它，让调度器开始下一轮，而不是等一个固定的扫描周期。"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.h4, {
      id: "popcycle-防止错过调度期间的资源变化",
      children: "popCycle 防止错过调度期间的资源变化"
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["还有一个并发边界：资源变化可能正好发生在 Workload 被 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "Pop"
      }), " 之后、调度失败重新入队之前。例如 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "train-a"
      }), " 正在计算 GPU 分配时，另一个 Workload 恰好完成并释放 GPU。如果事件处理只扫描当时的 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "inadmissibleWorkloads"
      }), "，由于 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "train-a"
      }), " 仍处于 inflight，它不会被扫描到；随后它再进入 inadmissible 集合，就会错过刚才那次唤醒。"]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "ClusterQueue"
      }), " 使用 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "popCycle"
      }), " 和 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "queueInadmissibleCycle"
      }), " 记录这两个动作的先后关系。", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "Pop"
      }), " 增加 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "popCycle"
      }), "，", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "QueueInadmissibleWorkloads"
      }), " 保存当时看到的 cycle。失败 Workload 重新入队时，如果发现自己被 Pop 之后已经发生过一次 inadmissible 重排，就直接进入 active heap，而不是进入暂存集。这样，调度期间发生的资源释放不会变成一次丢失的重试机会。"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.h4, {
      id: "backoff-是另一条定时重入路径",
      children: "backoff 是另一条定时重入路径"
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["事件驱动的 inadmissible 重排与 Workload backoff 不是一回事。Workload 被驱逐并配置退避时，", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "status.requeueState.requeueAt"
      }), " 会记录允许重新排队的时间。Workload controller 根据剩余时间注册 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "time.AfterFunc"
      }), "；时间到达后重新读取 Workload，确认它仍处于 Pending，再调用 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "AddOrUpdateWorkload"
      }), " 放回队列。"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "因此可以把重新尝试分成两类："
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.ul, {
      children: ["\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: ["资源、配额、ResourceFlavor 或 selector 等条件不满足：主要等待相关集群事件，再从 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "inadmissibleWorkloads"
        }), " 移回 active heap；"]
      }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: ["驱逐后的 backoff：等待 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "requeueAt"
        }), "，由定时回调重新入队。"]
      }), "\n"]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["Workload 回到 active heap 后并不保证下一次一定准入。如果触发事件没有真正解决它所需的条件，它会再次尝试失败，并根据 QueueingStrategy 回到 active heap 或 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "inadmissibleWorkloads"
      }), "。这条循环解释了为什么一个 Workload 可以长期保持 Pending，但并不会持续占用每一次调度周期。"]

      children: [_jsx(_components.code, {

      })
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: [_jsx(_components.code, {

        children: "parameters"

        children: "admissionChecksStrategy"
      }), " 只对使用特定 ResourceFlavor 的 Workload执行。controller 的结果保存在每个 Workload 自己的 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "status.admissionChecks"

        children: "Pending"
      }), "、", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "Ready"

        children: "Retry"

        children: "Rejected"

        children: "podSetUpdates"

    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {

    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {

    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "IssuePreemptions"
      }), " 只是给 victim 写入驱逐相关 condition。jobframework 随后停止对应 Job，workload controller 清除它的 quota reservation，Cache 才真正减掉用量。这个过程跨越多个 controller reconcile，不是一次原子的“旧 Workload 退出、新 Workload 立即换入”。"]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["因此，已经发起抢占的 Workload 会以 ", _jsx(_components.code, {

    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {

      })
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "如果等待期间队列里出现了更高优先级 Workload、quota 配置改变，或者其他 Workload 先使用了刚释放的额度，原抢占者重新计算后也不保证一定准入。抢占结果描述的是当前 snapshot 上的一条可行释放路径，不是对未来配额的永久锁定。"
    }), "\n", _jsx(ObsidianCallout, {

      children: _jsx(_components.p, {
        children: "如果两个 ResourceFlavor 的 nodeLabels 实际选中同一批 GPU 节点，但管理员又分别为它们配置完整 GPU quota，Kueue 会把它们视为两个独立 quota pool。两份 quota 不能互相填补缺口，账本还可能认为两边都可以准入，最终由 kube-scheduler 因物理 GPU 不足把 Pod 留在 Pending。设计 flavor 和 quota 时，应避免把同一份物理容量重复计算。"
      })
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.h3, {

    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["Kueue 中容易混淆的 Fair Sharing 实际有两套机制。Preemption Fair Sharing 面向同一 Cohort 的 ClusterQueue：每个 ClusterQueue 根据借用资源量和 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: ".spec.fairSharing.weight"
      }), " 计算 weighted share，准入时偏向 share 较低的队列，抢占时优先从 share 较高的队列选择目标。它解决的是多个租户长期共享 Cohort 闲置配额时，如何避免先到的队列持续占满借用资源。"]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["Admission Fair Sharing 则面向同一 ClusterQueue 下的多个 LocalQueue。启用 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "AdmissionFairSharing"
      }), " 后，Kueue 记录各 LocalQueue 的历史资源使用量并随时间衰减，调度时偏向历史使用较少的 LocalQueue。它改变的是 ClusterQueue heap 中 Workload 的比较结果，不依赖通过驱逐来恢复公平。"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "例如 team-a-cq 和 team-b-cq 同属一个 Cohort，权重相同，但 team-a-cq 已大量借用 CPU。新的 Workload 同时等待时，Preemption Fair Sharing 会优先照顾 weighted share 更低的 team-b-cq；如果 team-a-cq 内部又有 research 和 batch 两个 LocalQueue，Admission Fair Sharing 还能在该 CQ 内优先选择近期用量更少的一方。前者比较 ClusterQueue，后者比较 LocalQueue，不能只用一个“公平共享”概念代替。"
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["至此，Kueue 已经完成 quota reservation，并在所有 AdmissionCheck Ready 时把 Workload 置为 ", _jsx(_components.code, {

          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "if"
        }), " node.HasParent() && val > localAvailable {\n        deltaParentUsage := val - localAvailable\n        addUsage(node.parentHRN(), fr, deltaParentUsage) ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-comment",
          children: "// 超出保底的部分记到 Cohort"
        }), "\n    }\n}\n"]
      })
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["也就是说：用量先记在本 CQ；只有当本 CQ 用超了自己的\"保底\"（", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "guaranteedQuota"
      }), "，见下）时，超出部分才向上记到 Cohort。这正是\"借用\"在账本上的体现。"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.h3, {
      id: "3-保底借用出借三者的关系",
      children: "3. 保底、借用、出借三者的关系"
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "guaranteedQuota"
      }), " 是\"本节点不会借给 Cohort 的那部分\"："]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsxs(_components.code, {
        className: "hljs language-go",
        children: [_jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-comment",
          children: "// pkg/cache/resource_node.go"
        }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-function",
          children: [_jsx(_components.span, {
            className: "hljs-keyword",
            children: "func"
          }), " ", _jsx(_components.span, {
            className: "hljs-params",
            children: "(r resourceNode)"
          })]
        }), " guaranteedQuota(fr resources.FlavorResource) ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-type",
          children: "int64"
        }), " {\n    ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "if"
        }), " lendingLimit := r.Quotas[fr].LendingLimit; lendingLimit != ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-literal",
          children: "nil"

          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "return"

          className: "hljs-number",
          children: "0"

          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "return"

          className: "hljs-number",
          children: "0"
        }), "   ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-comment",
          children: "// 没设 lendingLimit 时，全部可借出，保底为 0"
        }), "\n}\n"]
      })

      children: ["含义很直白：本 CQ 的保底 = ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "nominalQuota - lendingLimit"
      }), "。", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "- lendingLimit"

        children: "lendingLimit"
      }), " 为空，则整个 nominal 都可被借出（保底为 0）。"]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["判断\"还能不能再接一个 Workload\"的是 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "available"

    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsxs(_components.code, {
        className: "hljs language-go",
        children: [_jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-comment",
          children: "// pkg/cache/resource_node.go"
        }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-function",
          children: [_jsx(_components.span, {
            className: "hljs-keyword",
            children: "func"
          }), " ", _jsx(_components.span, {
            className: "hljs-title",
            children: "available"
          }), _jsx(_components.span, {
            className: "hljs-params",
            children: "(node hierarchicalResourceNode, fr resources.FlavorResource)"

          className: "hljs-type",
          children: "int64"

          className: "hljs-keyword",

          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "return"

          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "return"

      id: "3-workload-未准入时将-job-恢复为-suspendtrue",

        children: "suspend=true"
      })]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["同一函数还会处理一种状态不一致：Job 当前是 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "spec.suspend=false"
      }), "，已经处于允许创建 Pod 的状态，但对应 Workload 并没有 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "Admitted=True"
      }), "。此时 jobframework 会调用 ", _jsx(_components.code, {

        children: "spec.suspend=true"
      }), "，阻止它在未获得 Kueue 准入的情况下继续运行："]

      children: _jsxs(_components.code, {

        }), "\n", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-comment",
          children: "// 8. handle job is unsuspended."

          className: "hljs-keyword",

        }), " !workload.IsAdmitted(wl) {\n    log.V(", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-number",
          children: "2"
        }), ").Info(", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-string",
          children: "\"Running job is not admitted by a cluster queue, suspending\""
        }), ")\n    err := r.stopJob(ctx, job, wl, StopReasonNotAdmitted, ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-string",
          children: "\"Not admitted by cluster queue\""
        }), ")\n    ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "return"
        }), " ctrl.Result{}, err\n}\n"]
      })
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["这里的“挂起”专指恢复 Job 的 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "spec.suspend=true"
      }), "，不是暂停 scheduler，也不是把 Workload 放进 inadmissible 队列。这条分支保证未获得 Kueue 准入的 Job 不会继续创建和运行 Pod。"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.h3, {
      id: "4-waitforpodsready已经放行但整组-pod-没跑起来",
      children: "4. WaitForPodsReady：已经放行，但整组 Pod 没跑起来"
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "Admitted=True"
      }), " 只能说明 Kueue 已经完成配额预留并允许 Job 启动，不能保证 kube-scheduler 最终能让所有 Pod 都运行起来。节点资源碎片、PVC 挂载失败、镜像拉取失败以及 Pod 模板中的额外调度约束，都可能让一个 Workload 只启动一部分 Pod。"]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["例如，一个分布式训练任务需要 8 个 worker。Kueue 按 8 个 Pod 预留了配额并放行 Job，但集群最终只有 2 个 Pod Ready。训练无法开始，这个 Workload 却仍占着 8 个 Pod 对应的配额。", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "WaitForPodsReady"
      }), " 处理的就是这种“已经准入，但没有真正形成可运行整体”的情况。"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "它默认关闭，可以在 controller-manager 配置中启用："
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsxs(_components.code, {
        className: "hljs language-yaml",
        children: [_jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-attr",
          children: "waitForPodsReady:"
        }), "\n  ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-attr",
          children: "enable:"
        }), " ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-literal",
          children: "true"
        }), "\n  ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-attr",
          children: "timeout:"
        }), " ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-string",
          children: "5m"
        }), "\n  ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-attr",
          children: "blockAdmission:"
        }), " ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-literal",
          children: "true"
        }), "\n  ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-attr",
          children: "recoveryTimeout:"
        }), " ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-string",
          children: "3m"
        }), "\n  ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-attr",
          children: "requeuingStrategy:"
        }), "\n    ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-attr",
          children: "timestamp:"
        }), " ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-string",
          children: "Eviction"

    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {

          children: "true"

        children: [_jsx(_components.span, {

          children: "// pkg/controller/jobframework/reconciler.go"
        }), "\n", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-comment",
          children: "// 6. handle eviction"
        }), "\n", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "if"
        }), " evCond := apimeta.FindStatusCondition(wl.Status.Conditions, kueue.WorkloadEvicted); evCond != ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-literal",
          children: "nil"
        }), " && evCond.Status == metav1.ConditionTrue {\n    ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "if"
        }), " err := r.stopJob(ctx, job, wl, StopReasonWorkloadEvicted, evCond.Message); err != ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-literal",
          children: "nil"
        }), " {\n        ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "return"
        }), " ctrl.Result{}, err\n    }\n    ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "if"
        }), " workload.HasQuotaReservation(wl) {\n        ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "if"
        }), " !job.IsActive() {\n            setRequeued := evCond.Reason == kueue.WorkloadEvictedByPreemption\n            workload.SetRequeuedCondition(wl, evCond.Reason, evCond.Message, setRequeued)\n            _ = workload.UnsetQuotaReservationWithCondition(wl, ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-string",
          children: "\"Pending\""
        }), ", evCond.Message, r.clock.Now())\n            ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-comment",
          children: "// 配额 reservation 被清空 → workload controller 的 Update 事件会触发 cache.DeleteWorkload"
        }), "\n        }\n    }\n}\n"]
      })

      children: "常见\"一直 Pending\"的排查顺序："
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsxs(_components.code, {
        className: "hljs language-bash",
        children: [_jsx(_components.span, {

        }), "\nkubectl describe workload -n team-a train | sed -n ", _jsx(_components.span, {

    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.h2, {
      id: "九流程总结",
      children: "九、流程总结"
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "把前面的源码和示例压缩成一条端到端流程，大致可以分成下面几步："
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.ol, {
      children: ["\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: [_jsx(_components.strong, {
          children: "提交 Job"
        }), "：带上 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "kueue.x-k8s.io/queue-name"
        }), " 标签。Kueue 的 mutating webhook 把它置为 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "suspend: true"
        }), "，并由 jobframework 生成一个同名 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "Workload"
        }), "，", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "spec.queueName"
        }), " 指向对应 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "LocalQueue"
        }), "。"]
      }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: [_jsx(_components.strong, {
          children: "入队"
        }), "：", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "queue.Manager.AddOrUpdateWorkload"
        }), " 先把 Workload 放进 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "LocalQueue"
        }), " 的 items，再 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "PushOrUpdate"
        }), " 进 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "ClusterQueue"
        }), " 的堆，最后 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "Broadcast"
        }), " 唤醒可能在等待的调度器。"]
      }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: [_jsx(_components.strong, {
          children: "取队首 + 快照"
        }), "：调度器 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "Heads()"
        }), " 阻塞拿到各 CQ 队首；", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "cache.Snapshot"
        }), " 拷贝一份集群资源视图供本轮使用。"]
      }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: [_jsx(_components.strong, {
          children: "预筛 + flavor 分配"
        }), "：", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "nominate"
        }), " 做命名空间/资源/AdmissionCheck 校验，通过则调用 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "FlavorAssigner.Assign"
        }), " 算出每个 PodSet 的 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "ResourceFlavor"
        }), "、占用量与借用，得到 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "RepresentativeMode"
        }), "（Fit/Preempt/NoFit）。"]
      }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: [_jsx(_components.strong, {
          children: "排序与准入"
        }), "：迭代器按\"已预留 > 不借用 > 优先级 > FIFO\"弹出 entry；", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "Fit"
        }), " 的在快照上 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "AddUsage"
        }), " 后调用 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "admit"
        }), "。", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "admit"
        }), " 写 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "status.admission"
        }), "（", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "SetQuotaReservation"
        }), "）、置 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "QuotaReserved"
        }), "（全 check Ready 再置 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "Admitted"
        }), "），并立刻 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "cache.AssumeWorkload"
        }), " 更新内存账本，再异步用 SSA 写回 apiserver。"]
      }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: [_jsx(_components.strong, {
          children: "AdmissionCheck"
        }), "：配额预留只会得到 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "QuotaReserved=True"
        }), "；所有 AdmissionCheck 都变成 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "Ready"
        }), " 后，", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "SyncAdmittedCondition"
        }), " 才会设置 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "Admitted=True"
        }), "。", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "Retry"
        }), " 会重新等待，", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "Rejected"
        }), " 会触发驱逐与配额释放。"]
      }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: [_jsx(_components.strong, {
          children: "抢占"
        }), "：当结果是 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "Preempt"
        }), " 时，调度器先选出 victim 并发出驱逐，当前 Workload 进入等待；只有 victim 真正释放用量后，它才重新竞争并完成准入。"]
      }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: [_jsx(_components.strong, {
          children: "公平共享"
        }), "：Preemption Fair Sharing 用 CQ/Cohort 的加权份额影响跨 ClusterQueue 抢占；Admission Fair Sharing 则在同一 ClusterQueue 内影响 LocalQueue 的取队顺序。二者不是同一个开关，也不发生在同一层。"]
      }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: [_jsx(_components.strong, {
          children: "账本记账"
        }), "：", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "AssumeWorkload"
        }), " → ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "addOrUpdateWorkload"
        }), " → ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "updateWorkloadUsage"
        }), " → ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "addUsage"
        }), "。用量先记本 CQ，超出保底的部分向上冒泡到 Cohort，体现为\"借用\"。"]
      }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: [_jsx(_components.strong, {
          children: "放行"
        }), "：jobframework 的 reconciler 发现 Workload 已 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "Admitted"
        }), " 且 Job 仍挂起，调 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "startJob"
        }), "：从 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "status.admission"
        }), " 解析 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "PodSetAssignment"
        }), "，", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "RunWithPodSetsInfo"
        }), " 把 Job 的 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "suspend"
        }), " 置 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "false"
        }), " 并注入 flavor 的 nodeSelector/taints，Pod 交给 kube-scheduler 正常调度。"]
      }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: [_jsx(_components.strong, {
          children: "等待 PodsReady"
        }), "：启用 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "WaitForPodsReady"
        }), " 后，jobframework 把底层 Job 的启动情况写入 Workload Condition。首次启动或运行后恢复超过 timeout，Workload 会因 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "PodsReadyTimeout"
        }), " 被驱逐，释放配额并在退避后重新排队；它提供的是准入后的超时纠偏，不是严格的 Pod 级 gang scheduling。"]
      }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: [_jsx(_components.strong, {
          children: "回收"
        }), "：Job 完成后 Workload 标记 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "Finished"
        }), "；保留期过后被删除（或被抢占、PodsReady 超时、停用而驱逐），workload controller 的 Delete/Update 事件触发 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "cache.DeleteWorkload"
        }), " → ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "removeUsage"
        }), "，把用量按 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "addUsage"
        }), " 的反方向冒泡归还 Cohort，配额重新可用。"]
      }), "\n"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.h2, {
      id: "附录源码索引",
      children: "附录：源码索引"
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["本文以 Kueue 源码中的以下文件为主（基于仓库 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "sigs.k8s.io/kueue"
      }), "，main 分支，约 2026-02 提交 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "8d9b602"
      }), "）："]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.ul, {
      children: ["\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "pkg/queue/manager.go"
        }), "：队列管理，", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "AddOrUpdateWorkload"
        }), "（入队）、", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "Heads"
        }), "/", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "heads"
        }), "（取队首）、", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "Broadcast"
        }), "（唤醒调度器）、", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "requeueWorkloadsCQ"
        }), "（不可准入项重排）"]
      }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "pkg/scheduler/scheduler.go"
        }), "：调度主循环 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "schedule"
        }), "、", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "nominate"

function MDXContent(props = {}) {
  const {wrapper: MDXLayout} = {
    ..._provideComponents(),
    ...props.components
  };
  return MDXLayout ? _jsx(MDXLayout, {
    ...props,
    children: _jsx(_createMdxContent, {
      ...props
    })
  }) : _createMdxContent(props);
}
return {
  default: MDXContent
};
function _missingMdxReference(id, component) {
  throw new Error("Expected " + (component ? "component" : "object") + " `" + id + "` to be defined: you likely forgot to import, pass, or provide it.");
